name: :has() Sibling Dim Spotlight
description: Hovering any item in a grid dims every sibling and lifts the focused one, a focus-spotlight interaction built with pure CSS and no JavaScript.
usage: Drop styles.css into your stylesheet and wrap focusable cards in a .spotlight-grid using the markup from index.html. Hover or keyboard-focus any .spotlight-card and its siblings dim while it lifts — no script required.
license: LogRocket Blog article — code snippets free to reuse; reimplemented cleanly. :has() is native Baseline CSS.
